inbox.subject: Burn multiple for the deck
inbox.body:
Alex,

Heads up before our 9:30am. Burn multiple comes in at 2.8 for the trailing quarter going into the board deck. Most of it is the Q4 care lead hiring and the Boston overtime. ARR is at $17.8M and we are forecasting a $1.2M gap to the $19M year end plan.

Also a reminder that the board moved from Friday to Thursday, 9am, so I need final numbers locked by 6pm today. I'd like to show the 2.8 with a bridge to where it lands once the Q1 hires ramp. Happy to talk options.

Julian

inbox.subject: Re: Board meeting moved to Thursday
inbox.body:
Alex,

Thursday at 9 works for me, thanks for moving it. We'll host at our offices as planned. Please get the deck to the group by tonight if you can so people have the evening to read.

Best,
Helen

inbox.subject: Lunch today
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Looking forward to lunch at Larkspur Grill at 12:30pm. Diane mentioned you might be tight today, so I'm happy to keep it to an hour. I'd mainly like to understand how employee data flows into CareBird and what my team needs to do before January.

Best,
Celeste Navarro
Chief Information Officer, Harborline Mutual

inbox.subject: VP of Care: Theo Ranganathan, Thursday 5pm
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Theo can only do Thursday this week before his other final rounds, so I've squeezed him in at 5pm on Thursday, after your board. Forty five minutes on video. He ran care operations for a 300-person home health network and has scaled a coordinator team from 20 to 90.

Resume and my notes attached. Let me know if you want Jordan to join.

Grace

inbox.subject: Brand campaign strategy, due today
inbox.body:
Alex,

The brand marketing campaign strategy is due today. Draft is in the shared folder. Short version: one winter campaign built around adult children planning for the holidays, Family as the hero product, Expert Bench at the $99 seasonal price as the entry point.

We'll go through it at 10:30am. I need your call on the budget level so Keisha can brief the agency Thursday.

Tomás

inbox.subject: Board prep vs Harborline lunch
inbox.body:
Alex,

Your Harborline CIO lunch at 12:30pm overlaps the board prep block from 12pm to 2pm. Options: I run the first half and you join at 1:45pm for the ops and finance sections, or we push prep to 2pm and move your Priya check-in. Your call, tell me by 10.

Jordan

inbox.subject: Incident status for the board slide
inbox.body:
Alex,

Still one open privacy incident. Root cause is confirmed and affected users were notified Monday. I expect to close it next week. Proposed one-line wording for the risk slide is in the doc. Can review at 4:30pm.

Nadia

inbox.subject: Donna update
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Quick update on your mom. Donna's cardiology follow-up moved to Monday at 10:30am because the doctor was out. I've rebooked her ride and Tommy will cover if I'm out that morning. Her new blood pressure medication refill is ready at the pharmacy and I've arranged delivery for Thursday.

Erika

inbox.subject: Thanksgiving
inbox.body:
Hey,

Are we still doing Thanksgiving at Aunt Donna's place? I can bring pies and pick up the rolls. Let me know headcount when you get a sec, I know it's a crazy week.

Sai

inbox.subject: HVAC maintenance Friday
inbox.body:
Hello,

Scheduled HVAC maintenance on floors 6 and 7 this Friday, November 20, from 7am to 11am. Expect some noise and reduced airflow in the east conference rooms.

Facilities Desk
Brightwell Properties

newsletters.title: Employers rethink caregiving benefits for 2027
newsletters.body: A survey of 400 HR leaders finds caregiving support moving into core benefits packages, with insurers and large employers leading adoption. Budgets for 2027 are flat overall but caregiving lines are up.

newsletters.title: Care coordination funding round-up
newsletters.body: Three care coordination startups closed rounds this month. Investors are focusing on efficiency metrics, including burn multiples and staff minutes per household, more than top line growth.
